question: What mantra-root is to be used at the conclusion of the worship?
premises: The action takes place at the end of worship.
A root of twenty-five syllables is specified.
The instruction is addressed to the supreme goddess.
inference: At the end of the worship, the twenty-five-syllable root mantra is to be used.
plain_english: At the end of the worship, O supreme goddess, use the root of twenty-five syllables.
